initialFinding: Cancellation at check2 did not reach first write; check3 revealed EISDIR in newly created empty root cleanup.
resolution: Regression observes first created file at check3, rejects rollback failed diagnostics, verifies both new roots removed and full original proposal retained. Production cleanup uses non-recursive rmdir.
concurrencyAssessment: rmdir only removes an empty directory. A concurrent addition after the emptiness check prevents removal with ENOTEMPTY, preserving the file and reporting cleanup failure.
limits: Offline parent protocol and actual writer rollback only; no inference or full learning pipeline.
Earlier real inference uses its frozen pre-cleanup runtime hash.

nativeIndependentReview.limit: Removed containers cannot independently expose runtime network/read-only configuration; those settings are preserved invocation evidence.
